assessment: In this work the authors perform a rigorous and detailed analysis of the cellular and molecular basis for food type influences on reproduction in C. elegans. Their experiments show convincingly that the effects of food type on oogenesis and fertilization are controlled by distinct cellular and molecular pathways. These important findings illuminate a role for insulin-like peptides in linking food type with reproduction and provide a framework for understanding evolutionary forces that may have shaped insulin-like signaling pathways in invertebrates.
